item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hi there! Here's your weather for Tuesday, September 15. Tuesday already. Well done for a good start! In Shanghai today, expect it to be cloudy. It will reach 29 degrees, and drop down to 22 degrees. It should feel gently warm all day. There is almost no chance of rain today. Did you know today is day 258 of the year? There are 107 days to go until the new one. Grey skies are still good for the park. Bring your ball! And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be cloudy with hardly any sun, with a high of 30 degrees. What would you tell a friend about school bags and desks? That's your weather. Have a wonderful day!
